records.title: ERMoE: Eigen-Reparameterized Mixture-of-Experts for Stable Routing and Interpretable Specialization
records.reason: ERMoE studies eigen-reparameterized MoE routing on image/MRI tasks. Although it measures a small inference-time reduction, the method and evidence are vision-specific rather than LLM serving or expert inference.

records.title: MMaDA-Parallel: Multimodal Large Diffusion Language Models for Thinking-Aware Editing and Generation
records.reason: MMaDA-Parallel is a multimodal diffusion language model for editing/generation and uses parallel sampling of output tokens. The work does not report a direct latency or throughput comparison demonstrating inference acceleration.

records.title: Synapse: Adaptive Arbitration of Complementary Expertise in Time Series Foundational Models
records.reason: Synapse arbitrates experts for time-series foundation models. The problem and evaluation are time-series forecasting, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Artificial neural network model based on Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem and retention mechanism for real-time aircraft flight phases classification
records.reason: Publisher title identifies an ANN for aircraft flight-phase classification, unrelated to LLM inference/serving.

records.title: AutoLab: Can Frontier Models Solve Long-Horizon Auto Research and Engineering Tasks?
records.reason: AutoLab measures whether frontier models can solve long-horizon auto-research/engineering tasks. It is a capability benchmark, not a runtime optimization.
